title: Acme weekly sync
rawTranscript:
Alex Rivera: Morning all. Main thing today is the Falcon beta date.
Sam Lee: Our QA found two blocking bugs in the export flow. We can't make November 5th.
Priya Shah: Engineering agrees. If we fix both this week, November 12th is realistic.
Alex Rivera: Okay, let's agree: we move the beta to November 12th. Sam, can you send the revised proposal with the new date by Friday?
Sam Lee: Yes, I'll have it to you Friday.
Priya Shah: I'll book a design review for the export flow with Ben.
Alex Rivera: Great. One thing we haven't settled is whether the beta includes the SSO feature.
Sam Lee: Let's leave that open until we hear from our security team.
Alex Rivera: Also, someone needs to confirm the budget with finance.
Priya Shah: Not sure who owns that one. Let's figure it out next week.
